Job Description

• Mengawasi dan memastikan kelancaran proses distribusi produk dari pabrik maupun gudang ke pelanggan.
• Menyusun dan mengontrol jadwal pengiriman agar sesuai dengan kebutuhan pelanggan.
• Mengoptimalkan rute, kapasitas angkut, dan biaya pengiriman untuk meningkatkan efisiensi logistik.
• Mengelola dan mengevaluasi kinerja transporter berdasarkan ketepatan waktu, biaya, dan kualitas layanan.
• Memastikan seluruh proses pengiriman berjalan sesuai SOP dan standar pelayanan perusahaan.
• Berkoordinasi dengan tim Sales, Warehouse, dan pihak terkait untuk memastikan pemenuhan pesanan pelanggan.
• Menangani kendala operasional, keterlambatan, dan klaim pengiriman serta menentukan tindakan perbaikan.
• Memimpin dan mengevaluasi kinerja tim administrasi logistik.
• Melakukan monitoring KPI logistik serta menyusun laporan dan evaluasi operasional secara berkala.

Requirements

• Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Logistik, Supply Chain Management, Teknik Industri, Manajemen, atau jurusan terkait.
• Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang logistik atau distribusi, diutamakan industri FMCG atau Food & Beverage.
• Memiliki pengalaman dalam mengawasi tim operasional logistik atau administrasi distribusi.
• Memahami proses distribusi, pengelolaan transporter, perencanaan pengiriman, dan pengendalian biaya logistik.
• Memiliki kemampuan analisis, problem solving, dan pengambilan keputusan yang baik.
• Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel dan sistem ERP atau aplikasi logistik.
• Memiliki kemampuan leadership, komunikasi, dan koordinasi lintas departemen.
• Terbiasa bekerja dengan target ketepatan pengiriman dan efisiensi biaya.
• Bersedia bekerja mobile & ditempatkan di Ngawi, Jawa Timur.

Job Description

• Oversee and ensure the smooth distribution of products from factories or warehouses to customers.
• Develop and manage delivery schedules to meet customer requirements.
• Optimize routes, transport capacity, and shipping costs to enhance logistics efficiency.
• Manage and evaluate the performance of transporters based on timeliness, cost, and service quality.
• Ensure all delivery processes adhere to the company’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and service standards.
• Coordinate with the Sales and Warehouse teams, as well as other relevant stakeholders, to ensure the fulfillment of customer orders.
• Address operational issues, delays, and delivery-related claims, and determine appropriate corrective actions.
• Lead and drive the performance of the logistics administration team.
• Monitor logistics KPIs and develop operational plans and evaluations on a regular basis.

Requirements

• Diploma (D3) or Bachelor’s (S1) degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Management, or a related field.
• At least 3 years of experience in logistics or distribution; experience in the FMCG or Food & Beverage industry is preferred.
• Experience in overseeing logistics operations or distribution administration.
• Strong understanding of distribution processes, transporter management, delivery planning, and logistics cost control.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems or logistics software.
• Strong leadership, communication, and cross-departmental coordination skills.
• Accustomed to working toward targets for delivery accuracy and cost efficiency.
• Willing to work in a mobile capacity and be based in Ngawi, East Java.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
